beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Other literary forms can also matter deeply to small audiences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A library can preserve that cultural diversity without requiring mass appeal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask the AI Librarian about the subject you want to explore.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Describe your question, your interests, or the kind of fiction you enjoy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The librarian recommends books from this collection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Open a book to see what it covers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Choose the ten-minute edition for a first look.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Switch to the complete book when you want the detail.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some books also have an animated introduction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Choose your reading language on the book page.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If a translation is missing, you can request it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Use Suggest an Edit to challenge a passage or add expert guidance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Use Create to propose a missing book or contribute a document.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with a question that deserves more than a quick answer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask the librarian, find a book, and take the time to explore.
